description: Audit a domain's email setup in one call: MX records, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DNSSEC and BIMI, graded A-F with a fix for every problem found. Use this to answer "can this domain send and receive mail" or "why do our messages land in spam". Takes a domain (example.com), not an email address. The default answer summarises every section; pass `section` to get the full records and findings of one of them.

dkim_selector.description: Optional DKIM selector to look up, e.g. "google" or "s1". Omit if unknown.

section.description: Drill into a single section instead of the whole summary

name: check_domain
title: Check a domain mail configuration
